notIdeasOfWhatSocietyShouldBe.explanation: Wikipedia defines doctrine as "a codification of beliefs or a body of teachings or instructions" in any belief system, religious, legal, philosophical or military; it names a kind of text, not a set of political ideas. I went through the statements looking for a position its sources state and found none: the article gives examples (Trinity, double predestination, Epicurus' principal doctrines, tactical doctrine) but no stance on how to run a society.
